method.what: SSO woodwinds' and brass' Long against CC1, EVERY semitone over the Long's sounding range of sso_winds_cc1_curves.json (its low .. high): the 23 main patches (solo, a2, a6) of real_range.py WINDS
method.measured: 2026-10-28 on the Windows 11 test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8 (VST 3), offline, by the VM's test host kthost (build 490), one process and one transport start per chunk of <= 12 pitches, 44.1 kHz stereo float, 512-frame blocks split at each event
method.setups: per patch (each section's stateKind): 'alltech-musescore-setup' the All techniques setup MuseScore made from the .nki (maker 2, $iooxo=3), resaved by Kontakt, unedited, as the 3-semitone sweep; 'long-vialsso-setup' / 'long-made' the library's '<instrument> - Long' patch at its defaults (the Long alone). Checked: at the pitches both sweeps share every patch agrees with the 3-semitone All techniques curve (median difference 0.00 dB, largest 0.28 dB in loudDb, 0.10 in rmsDb; Motif Horns a4 / Trombones a5 loudDb up to 1.6 dB at single points, rmsDb 0.00), so the Long patch is the All techniques Long
method.events: as sso_winds_cc1_curves.json, --step 1: CC32 1 and CC11 127 once; a warm-up note; per pitch, per CC1 value 16 .. 127, 4 notes in a row, held 3.0 s, 1.5 s apart, velocity = CC1, CC1 sent 1 s before its note-on
method.takes: 4 per point, rmsDbTakes each take's rmsDb in order (A B A B: two round robins alternate where the patch has them; the median is their mean). |A - B| per point: median 0.4-1.5 dB per patch, up to 11.6 dB (Bass Flute); the solo strings, Motif patches, Oboes a2 and Clarinet Solo one sample per point

measures.rmsDb: mean power of both channels 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, dB full scale
measures.lufs: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness (pyloudnorm 0.2.0) of the note-on to the note-off, LUFS
measures.sones: ISO 532-1 stationary loudness (mosqito 1.2.1 loudness_zwst, free field, resampled to 48 kHz) of the mid channel 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, samples as pascals: only ratios mean anything
measures.loudDb: the dynamics check's measure: the loudest 50 ms (25 ms hop) of the note and 0.5 s of its release
measures.loud1sDb: the same over the note's first 1.0 s and 0.5 s more

method.points: per pitch, per CC1: the median of the 4 takes and their spread (max - min); rmsDbTakes each take's rmsDb in the order played
method.relative64: per measure: [cc, median over pitches of (value - value at CC1 64; sones: ratio), min, max, pitches, median repeat spread, largest repeat spread]
